label: Overall
note: The column total. Every line in the cohort's line, matched by definition rather than by category. The transplant-only labels Allogeneic SCT (no regimen recorded) and Autologous SCT (no regimen recorded) land here and in no other column, so the class columns do not sum to this one.

label: Pom-based triplets (Non-aCD38)
note: GAP: the study vocabulary has no pomalidomide category. The package folds these lines into Other triplet (non-anti-CD38). Separating them needs the regimen string S_SOC.REGIMEN and a pomalidomide CL_MED_ABBR in soc_regimen_categories.csv.

label: Other Triplets
note: Carries the lines the shell's Pom-based triplets column asks for as well, until POM_TRIP can be split out.

label: BCMA
note: The cell therapies. A BCMA-directed bispecific is counted under Bi-specific instead, so the two columns are disjoint and a patient is in one column only. The study records CAR-T without its target, so a CAR-T directed at anything else lands here too.

label: Bi-specific
note: Both bispecific categories, BCMA-directed and not. The BCMA column beside it holds the cell therapies only, so the two do not overlap.

label: Other
note: More than one SOC_CATEGORY. Where a table also prints an Other novel agents line of its own (T2x), drop Other novel agent from here.

label: Other novel agents
note: T2x prints this as a row of its own. It is a subset of the Other column above.
